title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: DFA’ing VerHagen had to be an Al decision. Gardy was short about it the next day ... Why not give him time to work it out with you —he was set back with the injury, had a great 2nd half (your 7th inn. guy coming into spring) and it’s only May! Instead, they keep █████████, who consistently throws center-cut pitches and cannot get big lg hitters out. VerHagen could have pitched the 7th or 8th with a 7-run lead tonight, maybe even could have avoided using ███. Sorry so late, this is what is on my mind at the bar lol
